name: Alien Hordes
summary:
A space marine stationed on the moon in a secret weapons testing crater receives a message that all Earth's defences have been disabled by a mysterious force. All contact is lost. Then the battleships of an alien race emerge from jump points over the horizon. He suddenly realises he is the only one who can stop the devastation that's on it's way to Earth.

**Battle endless alien ships and creatures in this epic shooter from Brow Of The Hill.**
